aerial-a.giveaway: Every island is ringed by the same constant-width bright-white foam band and covered in identical dark-green tree blobs, while the water has no sun glitter at all and the cumulus sit on flat opaque undersides.

entries.condition: 1256 ft, noon, chase camera matching reference_a
entries.evidence: Each island coastline carries a continuous white band of constant width and brightness that follows the shoreline exactly, including the small keys at B4 and H5.
entries.defect: Uniform foam ring: no density variation, no broken edges, no dependence on wave exposure or beach slope.
entries.fix: Drive shoreline foam from wave-shore intersection noise and depth slope; break it into patches with variable width, opacity and lifetime and remove it from lee shores.

entries.evidence: The island canopy is a field of same-size, same-hue dark-green spheres with no trunks, no species mix, no shading between crowns and no shadow on the ground.
entries.defect: Clone trees at uniform spacing; canopy reads as broccoli texture, not vegetation.
entries.fix: Mix 4-6 species with size variation and clustering noise, add crown self-shadow and ground contact shadows, expose trunks at canopy edges and along the beach.

entries.evidence: Clouds are smooth cotton lobes; the undersides at D1-E1 and G1-H2 are dead level grey planes with no wisps or erosion; the reference shows ragged multi-scale bases.
entries.defect: Flat opaque cloud bases with no internal volume or erosion.
entries.fix: Add a second erosion noise octave at the base, height-fade density so the base is ragged, and a single-scatter silver lining term toward the sun.

entries.evidence: The whole bay is a matte turquoise gradient; there is no specular glitter path, no cloud reflections and the aircraft casts no reflection under G7.
entries.defect: Missing specular sun path and reflection of the sky/aircraft; water reads as a coloured surface, not a reflective one.
entries.fix: Add a GGX specular term with wave-slope-driven glitter and a planar/SSR reflection of the aircraft and clouds, attenuated by Fresnel.

entries.evidence: Downtown is a row of pale boxes of similar height with a flat top edge; there are no masts, spires, mechanical floors or roofline steps; the reference skyline has a clear hierarchy.
entries.defect: Skyline reads as differently sized rectangles without hierarchy or landmarks.
entries.fix: Add 3-4 landmark silhouettes (spire, crown, setback tower), rooftop masts and mechanical floors, and vary the pale colour with darker glass towers.

entries.evidence: Buildings are flat-shaded extrusions with a uniform window tint; no ledges or facade depth are visible even on the nearest blocks at C3.
entries.defect: No facade depth or parallax at any distance.
entries.fix: Add window inset normal maps and floor ledges to the mid-LOD, plus a few balcony racks on the beachfront towers.

entries.evidence: All facades are the same warm off-white; glass, concrete and stone are indistinguishable.
entries.defect: One material for the entire city.
entries.fix: Introduce glass curtain-wall towers with sky reflection, concrete with weathering streaks, and coloured pastel blocks at the beachfront.

entries.evidence: The causeway at A6-B6 is a flat grey ribbon with no railings, lamp posts or shoulders; the bridge at C4-E4 has plain box pylons with straight-line cable fans forming single triangles.
entries.defect: Highway reads as a road-coloured strip; no furniture legible from flying altitude.
entries.fix: Add guardrail ribbons, lamp post rows at 40 m spacing, edge barriers and a slightly raised deck edge; give the pylons real A/H shapes with cable anchor blocks.

entries.evidence: The boat at E8 trails a straight, bright, opaque white V with hard edges and no fading.
entries.defect: Opaque white wake streak with no Kelvin arms, stern turbulence or dissipation.
entries.fix: Replace the streak with a Kelvin-pattern wake texture that fades in alpha and width over time and gets displaced by the wave field.

entries.evidence: The hull is a white wedge with no windshield, seats or outboard visible.
entries.fix: Provide a 2k-tri speedboat with windshield, seats, outboard and railings for the mid LOD.

entries.evidence: The high-wing float plane reads correctly as a type; the wing is very thin in section and the tail is small relative to the fuselage.
entries.defect: Wing slab too thin, tail undersized.
entries.fix: Thicken the wing airfoil to about 12 percent chord and scale the vertical fin up 15 percent.

entries.evidence: Float struts and wing struts are present; no control-surface gaps or panel lines are legible at this distance.
entries.fix: Bake panel lines and control-surface gaps into the mid-LOD normal map.

entries.evidence: Wing is a uniform white slab with yellow tips; the trailing edge is as thick as the leading edge.
entries.defect: No airfoil taper; ailerons not distinguishable.
entries.fix: Model a tapered trailing edge and aileron/flap hinge gaps.

entries.evidence: The white and yellow paint are uniformly glossy with a plastic highlight and no panel-to-panel variation.
entries.defect: Uniform roughness over the whole airframe.
entries.fix: Add a roughness map with panel variation, subtle dirt behind the exhaust and on the float tops.

entries.evidence: Deep-to-shallow turquoise gradient around the island is attractive and close to the reference palette; surface structure is a single-scale noise with no swell.
entries.defect: No visible wave structure at altitude.
entries.fix: Add a long-wavelength swell normal layer and wind-streak anisotropy.

entries.evidence: Surface shows one frequency of ripples everywhere; no directional bias, no swell lines approaching the shore.
entries.fix: Sum at least three spectra (swell, wind sea, capillary) with a dominant direction toward the beach.

entries.evidence: Sand is a flat cream band that ends in a straight line at both the water and the vegetation; no wet sand, no shallow-water colour ramp within the beach width.
entries.defect: Hard texture boundaries on both sides of the beach.
entries.fix: Blend sand into water with a wet-sand darkening band and into vegetation with sparse grass scatter; drive the shallow water colour from depth.

entries.evidence: Exposure, sky gradient and horizon haze match the reference well; however no cast shadows exist under trees or buildings, so the island reads flat.
entries.defect: Missing shadows on the terrain and vegetation.
entries.fix: Enable shadow casting for the canopy impostors and building LODs in the far cascade.

entries.evidence: One boat, one house cluster at D5-E5 and no piers, moorings, roads or people on the islands.
entries.defect: World feels empty at meso scale.
entries.fix: Scatter docks, moored boats, a road loop and a few roofs on the large island.

entries.evidence: 42 fps average, 17.6 fps minimum, 289 draw calls, 1.10 M triangles, 343 MB heap, no console errors.
entries.fix: Reduce shadow cascade triangle count for far vegetation impostors.

cockpit-city.giveaway: The pilot's hands on the yoke are smooth tan mitts with fused fingers and the instrument panel is a flat decal whose digits float without bezels, under a headliner that is one uniform beige texture.

entries.evidence: Hands at D8 and F8 are featureless tan blobs; gauges at D6-E7 are flat textures with no bezel depth or glass; the MFD digits at F6-F7 float without backlight; the headliner A1-H2 is a flat beige with repeating ribs.
entries.defect: Cockpit lacks depth, material response and anatomy in the pilot.
entries.fix: Model gauge bezels and recessed dials with glass, add a real hand mesh with separated fingers gripping the yoke, and texture the headliner with fabric normal and stitching.

entries.evidence: A-pillars and the overhead panel at G2-H3 are flat dark grey with no wear, screws or texture.
entries.fix: Add plastic grain, screw heads, and scuffing on the pillars and overhead console.

entries.evidence: The windshield at D3-D4 shows a soft white streak that reads as a painted flare; the outside is washed out while the panel is evenly lit with no interior shadows.
entries.defect: Fake flare and no interior/exterior exposure relation.
entries.fix: Replace the streak with a physically placed sun glare on the glass and let the panel receive the sun through the windshield.

entries.evidence: Skyline is a pale, low-contrast set of boxes with almost no height variation.
entries.fix: Add landmark towers and roofline variation; darken glass towers for contrast.

entries.evidence: Buildings are untextured blocks; suburb at A6-B6 is a flat mottled texture.
entries.fix: Add window inset normals and roofline parapets to the mid LOD.

entries.evidence: Small cumulus at F4-G4 are cotton puffs with flat bases.
entries.fix: Ragged base erosion and height-fade density.

entries.evidence: Water is matte turquoise with no sky reflection or glitter.
entries.fix: Add specular sun path and sky reflection.

entries.evidence: Coastline is a hard sand-to-water line with a thin white edge.
entries.fix: Wet-sand band and depth-driven shallow colour.

entries.evidence: Mainland trees are uniform dark blobs.
entries.fix: Species and size variation, ground shadows.

entries.evidence: Shallow-water colour is attractive.
entries.defect: No surface structure at this distance.

entries.evidence: No boats, roads or traffic visible outside; interior has no charts, checklists or personal items.
entries.fix: Add a kneeboard, checklist card and headset cable inside; boats and traffic outside.

entries.evidence: 33 fps average, 13.5 fps minimum, 269 calls, 1.12 M triangles, no console errors.
entries.fix: Cull interior geometry from the shadow pass.

bridge-low.giveaway: The bridge deck is a perfectly flat ribbon with painted lane lines and no guardrails, joints or shoulders, its stay cables are straight lines fanning from plain box pylons, and the cars on it are untextured coloured blocks.

entries.condition: 171 ft, chase, alongside the cable-stayed bridge
entries.evidence: Deck is a flat grey plane with lane lines; the edge is a hard vertical cut with no barrier, guardrail, reflectors or drainage; pier caps at E7-F8 are plain cylinders.
entries.defect: No highway furniture at all on a hero bridge seen from 50 m.
entries.fix: Add concrete edge barriers, guardrail posts, expansion joint lines every 30 m, lamp posts at 40 m spacing and a pier cap with bearing blocks.

entries.evidence: A single lamp post is visible on a bridge over 1 km long.
entries.fix: Instance lamp posts along the deck spline on both sides.

entries.evidence: Cars are smooth coloured boxes with no wheels, windows or shadows.
entries.fix: Use a 500-tri car LOD with wheels, glass and a contact shadow.

entries.evidence: The propeller is a faint translucent grey disc with visible ghost blade copies rather than a coherent blurred disc.
entries.defect: Strobed ghost blades at high rpm.
entries.fix: Render a single alpha disc with radial blur texture whose alpha scales with rpm and hide the blade meshes above 1500 rpm.

entries.evidence: The island is outlined by a uniform white line.

entries.defect: Shadow on water is a crisp flat shape with no wave breakup or softening with distance.

entries.evidence: No glitter; the bridge, pylons and aircraft have no reflection in the water.

entries.evidence: Midtown blocks are identical extruded rectangles repeating on a grid with the same height and window pattern.
entries.fix: Vary footprint, height and facade per block with a seeded generator and add setbacks.

entries.evidence: A faint horizontal dashed line of lighter pixels crosses the entire frame at row 4 and a second at the bottom of row 3, parallel to the horizon.
entries.fix: Blend the near and far water LOD normals over a distance band and jitter the tile phase; verify the geometry seam is welded.

entries.evidence: Spray is straight thin white streaks trailing each float plus a symmetric fan of lines; no droplets, sheet, depression or bow wave; the water under the floats is undisturbed.

sunset.giveaway: The sun glitter path at E3-F8 is a wide band of constant width made of identical confetti sparkles, and every island at B3-G3 wears the same orange halo of lit shallow water.

entries.condition: golden hour, sun at E1 ahead
entries.evidence: The glitter path keeps the same width from the horizon to the aircraft, and every sparkle is a same-size dot; near the camera the water does not darken with Fresnel and there is no fragmented reflection of the aircraft.
entries.defect: Glitter not driven by wave slope; no Fresnel falloff.
